title: Auth token expiration causing login failures
description: Multiple users report unable to join due to expired JWT tokens.
rootCause: Token lifetime too short and refresh job lag
recommendedActions: Tune OAuth provider TTL and refresh skew
Add alert on refresh queue latency > 2s

title: WebSocket disconnect storm in us-east-1
description: Spike in signaling disconnects and reconnect attempts.
rootCause: Load balancer idle timeout too aggressive
previousResolutions: Increase ALB idle timeout from 60s to 180s
recommendedActions: Add synthetic client to detect early EOF

title: TURN relay allocation failures
description: TURN server returns allocation mismatch and 437 errors.
rootCause: NAT mapping timeout and port exhaustion
